title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 851–900 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: Teachers care about their students' growth and safety.
examples.zh: 老師們關心學生的成長與安全。

examples.en: I don't really care whether we go by train or bus as long as we arrive early.
examples.zh: 只要能早點抵達，我並不在意我們是搭火車還是搭公車。

examples.en: Take good care of your health by exercising and eating a balanced diet.
examples.zh: 透過運動與均衡飲食好好照顧自己的健康。

examples.en: Be careful when pouring hot boiling water.
examples.zh: 倒滾燙熱水時要小心。

examples.en: A careful driver always keeps a safe following distance on highways.
examples.zh: 謹慎的駕駛在高速公路上總是保持安全車距。

examples.en: She did a careful inspection of the contract before signing her name.
examples.zh: 在簽名前，她對合約進行了仔細審慎的檢查。

examples.en: Careless mistakes on the math test cost him points.
examples.zh: 數學測驗上的粗心錯誤讓他丟了分數。

examples.en: It was careless of me to leave my backpack behind at the cafe.
examples.zh: 把背包遺忘在咖啡館裡真是我太粗心大意了。

examples.en: Careless driving in bad weather easily leads to traffic accidents.
examples.zh: 在惡劣天候下草率粗心的駕駛容易釀成交通事故。

examples.en: It is polite to say 'excuse me' before asking directions.
examples.zh: 問路前先說聲「不好意思」是有禮貌的。

examples.en: The young hotel receptionist greeted international guests with a polite bow.
examples.zh: 年輕的飯店櫃檯接待員以彬彬有禮的鞠躬迎接外國貴賓。

examples.en: Always remember to be polite and respectful to elders and teachers.
examples.zh: 請始終記得對長輩與師長保持禮貌與敬意。

examples.en: Talking loudly in movie theaters is very impolite.
examples.zh: 在電影院裡大聲說話是非常沒禮貌的。

examples.en: It is considered impolite to chew with your mouth open at the table.
examples.zh: 在餐桌上咀嚼食物時張開嘴巴被視為很不禮貌。

examples.en: Staring rudely at strangers is an impolite habit you should avoid.
examples.zh: 無禮地盯著陌生人看是一項你應該避免的不禮貌舉止。

examples.en: Our English teacher is always patient with beginners.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師對初學者總是很有耐心。

examples.en: The doctor examined the elderly patient with great gentleness and empathy.
examples.zh: 醫生以極度的溫柔與同理心為年邁的病人看診。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language takes time, so be patient with yourself.
examples.zh: 學習一門外語需要時間，所以請對自己保持耐心。

examples.en: Don't get impatient while waiting in long lines.
examples.zh: 排長隊等候時不要變得焦躁不耐煩。

examples.en: The driver sounded his car horn impatiently in the traffic gridlock.
examples.zh: 司機在車陣大打結中焦躁不安地猛按汽車喇叭。

examples.en: Children often become impatient when waiting for their turn to open gifts.
examples.zh: 小孩子在輪候打開自己的禮物時往往會按捺不住焦急的心情。

examples.en: Honest communication builds mutual trust.
examples.zh: 誠實的溝通能建立彼此的信任。

examples.en: To be completely honest, I didn't enjoy that mystery thriller movie.
examples.zh: 老實說，我並不是很喜歡那部懸疑驚悚電影。

examples.en: The store owner rewarded the honest student who returned the lost wallet.
examples.zh: 店家老闆獎勵了拾金不昧、送還遺失皮夾的誠實學生。

examples.en: Cheating on exams is dishonest and strictly forbidden.
examples.zh: 考試作弊是不誠實且被嚴格禁止的。

examples.en: Making dishonest claims in advertising harms brand reputation severely.
examples.zh: 在廣告中做出不實且欺騙性的宣稱會嚴重損害品牌商譽。

examples.en: People eventually lose respect for anyone who engages in dishonest practices.
examples.zh: 人們最終會對任何從事不誠實行徑的人失去敬重。

examples.en: Don't be lazy; get up and do morning exercises.
examples.zh: 別偷懶了，起床做早操吧。

examples.en: We spent a lazy Sunday afternoon lounging on the beach reading books.
examples.zh: 我們在海灘上悠閒放鬆地看書，度過了一個慵懶的週日下午。

examples.en: A lazy attitude toward studying will hinder your long-term personal growth.
examples.zh: 對學業抱持懶散的態度會阻礙你長遠的個人成長。

examples.en: Hardworking students usually achieve their academic goals.
examples.zh: 勤勉用功的學生通常能達成學業目標。

examples.en: My parents are hardworking farmers who rise before dawn every morning.
examples.zh: 我的父母是勤勞樸實的農民，每天天未亮就早早起床。

examples.en: The promotion recognized her as the most hardworking and dedicated employee in the division.
examples.zh: 這次晉升肯定了她是部門中最勤勉且最敬業的員工。

examples.en: The new girl was too shy to speak in public.
examples.zh: 那位新來的女孩太害羞而不敢公開發言。

examples.en: He gave a shy smile when the teacher praised his art drawing.
examples.zh: 當老師稱讚他的美術畫作時，他靦腆地笑了笑。

examples.en: Joining the drama club helped him overcome feeling awkward and shy.
examples.zh: 加入戲劇社幫助他克服了感到彆扭與害羞的心態。

examples.en: Her outgoing personality makes it easy to make friends.
examples.zh: 她外向開朗的個性讓她很容易結交朋友。

examples.en: Highly outgoing individuals often thrive in customer relations and public relations roles.
examples.zh: 性格開朗外向的人往往在客戶服務與公共關係領域如魚得水。

examples.en: We need an outgoing team leader who can energize and motivate everyone.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位性格開朗外向、能鼓舞激勵大家的團隊領袖。

examples.en: The local Taiwanese villagers are exceptionally friendly.
examples.zh: 台灣當地的村民格外友善親切。

examples.en: The user-friendly interface makes the mobile app easy for elderly users to navigate.
examples.zh: 友善易用的人機介面讓年長的使用者能輕鬆操作這款手機 APP。

examples.en: A warm and friendly greeting sets a welcoming atmosphere for newcomers.
examples.zh: 一聲熱情友好的問候能為新來者營造賓至如歸的融洽氛圍。

examples.en: Call your grandparents so they won't feel lonely.
examples.zh: 打通電話給祖父母，讓他們不會感到孤單。

examples.en: Moving to a bustling foreign city alone can feel quite lonely at first.
examples.zh: 隻身搬遷到繁華的異國城市起初可能會感到相當孤寂寂寞。

examples.en: Adopting a rescue dog helped heal her lonely heart after moving away.
examples.zh: 在搬家後，領養一隻流浪搜救犬撫平了她孤獨寂寞的心靈。

examples.en: Parents are always proud of their children's achievements.
examples.zh: 父母總是為子女的成就感到無比自豪。

examples.en: The Olympic gold medalist felt proud to represent Taiwan on the global stage.
examples.zh: 奧運金牌得主為能在世界舞台上代表台灣而深感榮耀自豪。

examples.en: She stood tall with a proud smile as she received her college diploma.
examples.zh: 在領取大學畢業證書時，她昂首挺胸、臉上洋溢著自豪的笑容。

examples.en: Take a deep breath if you feel nervous before a speech.
examples.zh: 演講前如果感到緊張，請深吸一口氣。

examples.en: Job applicants naturally feel nervous during final executive interviews.
examples.zh: 求職者在進行高階主管最終面試時難免會感到緊張緊張。

examples.en: Listening to calming instrumental music soothes nervous tension before big exams.
examples.zh: 在大考前聆聽舒緩的純音樂能撫平緊繃的焦慮情緒。

examples.en: Listening to acoustic guitar music makes me feel relaxed.
examples.zh: 聆聽木吉他音樂讓我感到心情非常放鬆。

examples.en: The hotel lounge offers a quiet, relaxed atmosphere for reading and casual chatting.
examples.zh: 飯店交誼廳提供了一個安靜悠閒的放鬆氛圍供人閱讀與輕鬆聊天。

examples.en: After finishing the final exams, the high school students looked visibly relaxed.
examples.zh: 期末考結束後，高中生們個個看起來明顯放鬆了許多。

examples.en: Stay calm and follow instructions during an earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震發生時請保持冷靜並遵循指示。

examples.en: The doctor's gentle voice helped calm down the crying child in the clinic.
examples.zh: 診所裡醫生溫柔的嗓音幫助撫慰並平息了哭泣的孩子。

examples.en: The calm blue waters of the harbor mirrored the morning clouds like glass.
examples.zh: 港灣平靜蔚藍的水面猶如玻璃般倒映著晨曦的雲彩。

examples.en: Dad got angry when I broke the antique vase.
examples.zh: 當我打破古董花瓶時爸爸非常生氣。

examples.en: It does not help to stay angry; let's talk and resolve our differences calmly.
examples.zh: 一直生氣無濟於事，讓我們心平氣和地溝通並化解分歧吧。

examples.en: Customers grew angry when the high-speed rail was delayed without prior notice.
examples.zh: 當高鐵未事先通知而延誤時，旅客們紛紛感到十分氣憤不滿。

examples.en: The convenient grocery store is just across the street.
examples.zh: 便利的雜貨店就在街道正對面。

examples.en: We took a ferry ride across the sunlit harbor to Cijin Island.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘渡輪橫越陽光普照的港灣前往旗津島。

examples.en: She glanced across the busy room and locked eyes with her dear friend.
examples.zh: 她望向熱鬧擁擠的房間對側，目光與她的摯友交會。

examples.en: The train speeds through the long Hsuehshan Tunnel.
examples.zh: 火車飛速穿過長長的雪山隧道。

examples.en: Sunshine filtered gently through the green leaves of the ancient banyan tree.
examples.zh: 陽光透過古老榕樹的翠綠樹葉柔和地灑落下來。

examples.en: We worked tirelessly through the night to prepare all the presentation slides.
examples.zh: 我們通宵達旦地工作，連夜準備所有的簡報投影片。

examples.en: We took a scenic stroll along the riverbank path.
examples.zh: 我們沿著河岸步道悠閒漫步。

examples.en: Bring your friend along so we can all enjoy the outdoor barbecue together.
examples.zh: 把你的朋友一起帶過來吧，這樣大家可以一起享受戶外烤肉。

examples.en: Planting flowering trees along rural highways beautifies the whole countryside.
examples.zh: 在鄉村公路沿線種植開花路樹美化了整個鄉村景致。

examples.en: We rode bicycles around Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 我們騎著自行車環繞日月潭。

examples.en: The morning bus should arrive around eight fifteen at the stop.
examples.zh: 早班公車應該會在八點十五分左右到達車站。

examples.en: Backpackers dream of embarking on a year-long journey around the world.
examples.zh: 背包客們夢想著能踏上一趟為期一年的環遊世界之旅。

examples.en: Walk past the bookstore and turn right at the corner.
examples.zh: 走過書店並在轉角處右轉。

examples.en: In the past, letters took weeks to travel across the oceans.
examples.zh: 在過去，信件漂洋過海需要耗費數週的時間。

examples.en: We cannot change the past, but we can actively build a brighter future.
examples.zh: 我們無法改變過去，但我們能夠積極開創更加光明的未來。

examples.en: The children ran excitedly toward the playground swing.
examples.zh: 小朋友們興奮地朝著遊樂場鞦韆跑去。

examples.en: He has always maintained a positive, open-minded attitude toward learning new skills.
examples.zh: 他對於學習新技能始終抱持著積極開放的心態。

examples.en: Donations from the charity concert will go toward funding local children's healthcare.
examples.zh: 這場慈善音樂會的所有捐款將全數用於資助當地兒童的醫療照護。

examples.en: Put the fresh vegetables into the shopping basket.
examples.zh: 把新鮮蔬菜放進購物籃中。

examples.en: The caterpillar transformed miraculously into a dazzling, colorful butterfly.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲奇蹟般地蛻變為一隻光彩奪目、色彩斑斕的蝴蝶。

examples.en: The police detective conducted an in-depth investigation into the suspicious bank transfer.
examples.zh: 警探針對這筆可疑的銀行轉帳展開了深入詳盡的調查。

examples.en: Step out of the train carefully when doors open.
examples.zh: 車門開啟時請小心踏出列車。

examples.en: The school water dispenser is temporarily out of order for routine maintenance.
examples.zh: 學校飲水機因例行保養維護目前暫時故障暫停使用。

examples.en: I am afraid we have run completely out of milk for coffee this morning.
examples.zh: 恐怕今天早上我們沖泡咖啡用的牛奶已經完全喝光了。

examples.en: Please get off the bus at the next bus stop.
examples.zh: 請在下一站公車站下車。

examples.en: Take off your muddy hiking boots before walking onto the clean wooden floor.
examples.zh: 踏上乾淨的木質地板前請先脫下沾滿泥巴的登山靴。

examples.en: The plane took off smoothly into the clear blue morning sky.
examples.zh: 飛機平穩起飛，直入晴朗湛藍的晨空之中。

examples.en: Look up at the bright twinkling stars in the night sky.
examples.zh: 抬頭仰望夜空中閃爍的明亮星星。

examples.en: The students stood up politely to greet the visiting guest professor.
examples.zh: 學生們彬彬有禮地起立向蒞臨參訪的客座教授問好。

examples.en: Wake up early to catch the crisp morning air and exercise in the park.
examples.zh: 早早起床呼吸清晨清新的空氣並在公園裡做運動。

examples.en: Sit down and enjoy a cup of hot green tea.
examples.zh: 坐下來喝杯熱綠茶放鬆一下吧。

examples.en: Rain poured down heavily throughout the stormy subtropical afternoon.
examples.zh: 暴風雨襲來的亞熱帶午後，傾盆大雨不停地下著。

examples.en: Write down your personal reflections in your journal before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 在就寢前把你的個人心得體悟記錄在手記中。

examples.en: The rainbow arched gracefully over the tall green trees.
examples.zh: 彩虹優美地高掛在翠綠大樹上方。

examples.en: The long examination period is finally over, and summer vacation has begun!
examples.zh: 漫長的考試週終於結束了，暑假正式展開囉！

examples.en: More than five thousand runners crossed over the scenic coastal bridge.
examples.zh: 超過五千名長跑跑者跨越了這座壯觀的跨海大橋。

examples.en: Come sit beside me so we can share the book.
examples.zh: 來坐在我旁邊，我們才能一起看這本書。

examples.en: A beautiful crystal vase filled with fresh lilies stood beside the bed.
examples.zh: 床邊擺放著一只插滿新鮮百合的美麗水晶花瓶。

examples.en: He parked his compact scooter right beside the convenience store entrance.
examples.zh: 他把輕巧的機車恰好停放在便利商店入口旁邊。

examples.en: Besides English, she speaks fluent French and Japanese.
examples.zh: 除了英語之外，她還能說流利的法語和日語。

examples.en: Besides that, we must factor in travel transportation expenses and meals.
examples.zh: 除此之外，我們還必須把交通差旅費與餐飲開銷納入考量。

examples.en: Who else is joining the weekend camping trip besides David and Jenny?
examples.zh: 除了大衛和珍妮之外，還有誰會參加週末的露營活動？

examples.en: Never go hiking in remote mountains without a guide.
examples.zh: 絕不要在沒有嚮導的情況下深入荒山健行。

examples.en: Without a doubt, hard work and dedication yield meaningful rewards.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問，辛勤耕耘與全心投入必能收穫豐碩回報。

examples.en: Plants cannot survive without sunlight, carbon dioxide, and adequate water.
examples.zh: 沒有陽光、二氧化碳與充足的水分，植物便無法生存。

examples.en: I like drinking hot pearl milk tea with less sugar.
examples.zh: 我喜歡喝微糖的熱珍珠奶茶。

examples.en: She loves spending her weekend afternoons cooking dinner with close friends.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在週末午後和親密摯友一起動手煮晚餐。

examples.en: Write your signature with a black ballpoint pen on the official form.
examples.zh: 請在正式表格上使用黑色原子筆簽上你的名字。

examples.en: This handmade birthday card is specially for you!
examples.zh: 這張手作生日卡片是特別為你製作的！

examples.en: Regular cardiovascular exercise is exceptionally good for heart health.
examples.zh: 規律的有氧心肺運動對心臟健康格外有益。

examples.en: For example, bananas and apples are rich in essential dietary vitamins.
examples.zh: 舉例來說，香蕉和蘋果富含人體不可或缺的膳食維生素。

examples.en: We learned interesting facts about marine life today.
examples.zh: 我們今天學到了許多關於海洋生物的有趣知識。

examples.en: The express train ride takes about forty-five minutes to reach Taipei Main Station.
examples.zh: 搭乘自強號列車大約需要四十五分鐘抵達台北火車站。

examples.en: What do you think about adopting a rescued stray kitten from the shelter?
examples.zh: 你對於從收容所認養一隻流浪小貓咪有什麼看法？

examples.en: She works diligently as an English teacher in Tainan.
examples.zh: 她在台南擔任英語老師，工作十分勤勉。

examples.en: Call me as soon as you arrive safely at the train station.
examples.zh: 當你平安抵達火車站時請立即撥通電話給我。

examples.en: As time passed, her confidence in conversational speaking grew tremendously.
examples.zh: 隨著時間推移，她在英語口語對話方面的自信心大幅增強。

examples.en: We travel around Taipei easily by MRT.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘捷運輕鬆暢遊台北。

examples.en: The cozy cafe is located by the picturesque riverside walkway.
examples.zh: 那家溫馨的咖啡館就座落在風景如畫的河畔步道旁。

examples.en: Please submit your final project reports by five o'clock on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 請在週五下午五點以前繳交你們的期末專案報告。

examples.en: Keep your cell phones silent during the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會進行期間請將手機調為靜音。

examples.en: Many families visit scenic national parks during the Lunar New Year holiday.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在農曆春節連假期間造訪風景優美的國家公園。

examples.en: Students took notes attentively during the informative guest history lecture.
examples.zh: 在內容豐富的客座歷史講座期間，學生們專注地做筆記。

examples.en: We chatted happily at the cafe until midnight.
examples.zh: 我們在咖啡廳愉快地聊天直到午夜。

examples.en: You cannot open the sealed examination booklet until the bell rings.
examples.zh: 在鐘聲響起之前，嚴禁拆開密封的試卷題本。

examples.en: Until now, scientists continue discovering new underwater marine species.
examples.zh: 時至今日，科學家們依然在持續發現全新的海底生物物種。

examples.en: I have studied English since elementary school.
examples.zh: 我從小學就開始學英文了。

examples.en: Ever since they met in college, they have remained inseparable friends.
examples.zh: 自從在大學相識以來，他們便一直是形影不離的摯友。

examples.en: Since the weather is pleasant and cool, let's have our dinner outdoors.
examples.zh: 既然天氣宜人且涼爽，我們就在戶外享用晚餐吧。

examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly before eating meals.
examples.zh: 吃飯前請務必將雙手徹底洗乾淨。

examples.en: Always review the lesson notes before taking the unit quiz.
examples.zh: 在參加單元小考之前，務必先複習課堂筆記。

examples.en: The peaceful mountain village looked just as enchanting as before.
examples.zh: 這座安詳的山村看起來就像以往一樣迷人美麗。

examples.en: Let's play basketball together after school today.
examples.zh: 今天放學後我們一起去打籃球吧。

examples.en: After completing the challenging university entrance exams, she felt huge relief.
examples.zh: 在考完具挑戰性的大學入學統測後，她感到如釋重負。

examples.en: After that wonderful experience, he decided to pursue a culinary career.
examples.zh: 在經歷了那次美好的體驗後，他毅然決定投身餐飲廚藝事業。

examples.en: Listen to pleasant music while doing your homework.
examples.zh: 寫作業時可以聽些悅耳的音樂。

examples.en: Some people prefer waking up early, while others work best late at night.
examples.zh: 有些人偏好早起工作，然而其他人則在深夜時效率最高。

examples.en: Let's sit on the park bench and rest our legs for a little while.
examples.zh: 我們在公園長椅上坐一下，稍微讓雙腿休息一會兒吧。

examples.en: Although it rained, we still enjoyed our weekend trip.
examples.zh: 雖然下雨，我們依然很享受週末旅行。

examples.en: Although English grammar seems complex at first, consistent practice makes it intuitive.
examples.zh: 雖然英語文法起初看起來很複雜，但持續練習會讓它變得直覺自然。

examples.en: Although he is busy managing his business, he always makes time for his family.
examples.zh: 儘管經營事業十分繁忙，他總會抽空陪伴家人。

words.definition: 甚至；即使；平坦的；偶數的

examples.en: Even small children know how to use smartphones today.
examples.zh: 如今連小小孩都知道如何使用智慧型手機。

examples.en: Even if it storms tomorrow, the charity indoor race will proceed as planned.
examples.zh: 即使明天暴風雨來襲，這場慈善室內路跑仍將按原定計畫舉行。

examples.en: Two, four, six, and eight are familiar examples of even numbers.
examples.zh: 二、四、六和八都是大家熟知的雙數（偶數）範例。

examples.en: It was late, but my brother was still studying.
examples.zh: 時間已經很晚了，但我哥哥依然在用功讀書。

examples.en: Stand still and smile while the photographer takes your portrait.
examples.zh: 當攝影師為你拍攝個人肖像時，請站好別動並露出微笑。

examples.en: The mystery surrounding the lost ancient kingdom still puzzles modern archaeologists.
examples.zh: 圍繞這座失落古王國的神秘謎團至今依然令現代考古學家百思不解。

examples.en: Have you finished your English composition yet?
examples.zh: 你的英文作文已經寫完了嗎？

examples.en: We haven't decided our holiday travel destination yet.
examples.zh: 我們尚未決定假期的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: The young athlete was tired yet determined to cross the marathon finish line.
examples.zh: 這位年輕運動員身心疲憊，然而依然下定決心衝過馬拉松終點線。
